import Mathlib

structure SCCGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def SCCGraph.well_formed (g : SCCGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.size (g : SCCGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.has_edge (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def SCCGraph.is_path (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def SCCGraph.has_path (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v

def SCCGraph.is_strongly_connected (g : SCCGraph) (comp : List Nat) : Prop :=
  comp.length > 0 ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ comp → u < g.size) ∧
  ∀ u v, u ∈ comp → v ∈ comp →
    (g.has_path u v ∧ g.has_path v u)

def SCCGraph.is_partition (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  -- Enforce no duplicate components to match index-based disjointness
  sccs.Nodup ∧ 
  -- All nodes covered
  (∀ u, u < g.size → ∃ comp, comp ∈ sccs ∧ u ∈ comp) ∧
  -- Disjoint
  (∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    ∀ u, u ∈ c1 → u ∉ c2)

def SCCGraph.scc_has_path (g : SCCGraph) (c1 c2 : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ u v, u ∈ c1 ∧ v ∈ c2 ∧ g.has_path u v

def SCCGraph.is_maximal_scc_structure (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    (g.scc_has_path c1 c2 → ¬ g.scc_has_path c2 c1)

def SCCGraph.is_valid_scc_result (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  g.is_partition sccs ∧
  (∀ c, c ∈ sccs → g.is_strongly_connected c) ∧
  g.is_maximal_scc_structure sccs

namespace Tarjan

/-- Reachability: reflexive-transitive closure of the edge relation. -/
def Reach (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop := Relation.ReflTransGen g.has_edge u v

/-- State of Tarjan's algorithm. -/
structure TState where
  disc : Nat → Nat
  low  : Nat → Nat
  cnt  : Nat
  stk  : List Nat
  comp : Nat → Nat
  ncmp : Nat

/-- Point update of a vertex-indexed table. -/
def upd (f : Nat → Nat) (k v : Nat) : Nat → Nat := fun x => if x = k then v else f x

/-- Label every vertex of the popped block with the fresh component id. -/
def assignAll (c : Nat → Nat) (b : List Nat) (i : Nat) : Nat → Nat :=
  fun x => if x ∈ b then i else c x

/-- Split the stack into the top block down to and including `v`, and the rest. -/
def popTo (v : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat × List Nat
  | [] => ([], [])
  | x :: rest =>
      if x = v then ([x], rest)
      else (x :: (popTo v rest).1, (popTo v rest).2)

/-- Push `v` on the stack and give it the next discovery index. -/
def pushSt (s : TState) (v : Nat) : TState :=
  { disc := upd s.disc v s.cnt, low := upd s.low v s.cnt, cnt := s.cnt + 1,
    stk := v :: s.stk, comp := s.comp, ncmp := s.ncmp }

/-- Record the final low-link value of `v` and, if `v` is an SCC root, pop its component. -/
def finishSt (s : TState) (v d l : Nat) : TState × Nat :=
  if l = d then
    ({ disc := s.disc, low := upd s.low v l, cnt := s.cnt,
       stk := (popTo v s.stk).2,
       comp := assignAll s.comp (popTo v s.stk).1 (s.ncmp + 1),
       ncmp := s.ncmp + 1 }, l)
  else ({ s with low := upd s.low v l }, l)

mutual

/-- Tarjan DFS from `v`; returns the new state and the low-link value of `v`. -/
def visit (g : SCCGraph) (fuel : Nat) (v : Nat) (s : TState) : TState × Nat :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => (s, 0)
  | fuel + 1 =>
    let r := visitEdges g fuel ((g.adj.getD v #[]).toList) (pushSt s v) s.cnt
    finishSt r.1 v s.cnt r.2
termination_by (fuel, 0)

/-- Fold over the adjacency list of the vertex currently being visited. -/
def visitEdges (g : SCCGraph) (fuel : Nat) (ws : List Nat) (s : TState) (lo : Nat) :
    TState × Nat :=
  match ws with
  | [] => (s, lo)
  | w :: ws' =>
    if s.disc w = 0 then
      let r := visit g fuel w s
      visitEdges g fuel ws' r.1 (min lo r.2)
    else if w ∈ s.stk then
      visitEdges g fuel ws' s (min lo (s.disc w))
    else visitEdges g fuel ws' s lo
termination_by (fuel, ws.length)

end

def initState : TState :=
  { disc := fun _ => 0, low := fun _ => 0, cnt := 1, stk := [], comp := fun _ => 0, ncmp := 0 }

/-- Driver: start a DFS at every not yet visited vertex. -/
def loop (g : SCCGraph) : Nat → Nat → TState → TState
  | 0, _, s => s
  | k + 1, i, s =>
      loop g k (i + 1) (if s.disc i = 0 then (visit g (g.adj.size + 1) i s).1 else s)

def run (g : SCCGraph) : TState := loop g g.adj.size 0 initState

/-- Number of not yet visited vertices; used as the fuel measure. -/
def unvis (g : SCCGraph) (s : TState) : Nat :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).countP (fun u => s.disc u == 0)

/-- The state only grows: old data is frozen and the old stack is a suffix of the new one. -/
def Grows (s s' : TState) : Prop :=
  (∀ u, s.disc u ≠ 0 → s'.disc u = s.disc u) ∧
  (∀ u, s.comp u ≠ 0 → s'.comp u = s.comp u) ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ s.stk → s'.low u = s.low u) ∧
  (∃ pre, s'.stk = pre ++ s.stk ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ pre → s.disc x = 0) ∧
  s.cnt ≤ s'.cnt ∧ s.ncmp ≤ s'.ncmp ∧
  (∀ u, s.disc u = 0 → s'.disc u ≠ 0 → s.cnt ≤ s'.disc u)

/-- Main state invariant of Tarjan's algorithm. -/
def Inv (g : SCCGraph) (s : TState) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ s.cnt ∧
  (∀ u, s.disc u < s.cnt) ∧
  (∀ u w, s.disc u ≠ 0 → s.disc u = s.disc w → u = w) ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ s.stk → u < g.adj.size ∧ s.disc u ≠ 0 ∧ s.comp u = 0) ∧
  List.Pairwise (fun a b => s.disc b < s.disc a ∧ Reach g b a) s.stk ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ s.stk → s.low u ≤ s.disc u ∧
      (s.low u < s.disc u → ∃ w, w ∈ s.stk ∧ s.disc w = s.low u ∧ Reach g u w)) ∧
  (∀ u, s.comp u ≠ 0 → u < g.adj.size ∧ s.disc u ≠ 0 ∧ 1 ≤ s.comp u ∧ s.comp u ≤ s.ncmp) ∧
  (∀ u, s.disc u ≠ 0 → u ∉ s.stk → s.comp u ≠ 0) ∧
  (∀ u v, s.comp u ≠ 0 → s.comp u = s.comp v → Reach g u v) ∧
  (∀ u w, s.comp u ≠ 0 → g.has_edge u w → s.comp w ≠ 0 ∧ s.comp w ≤ s.comp u) ∧
  (∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ s.ncmp → ∃ u, s.comp u = i)

/-- Specification of one call `visit g fuel v s` returning `(s', l)`. -/
def Post (g : SCCGraph) (v : Nat) (s s' : TState) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  Inv g s' ∧ Grows s s' ∧ s'.disc v = s.cnt ∧ l ≤ s.cnt ∧
  (l = s.cnt → s'.stk = s.stk ∧ s'.comp v ≠ 0) ∧
  (l < s.cnt → s'.low v = l ∧ v ∈ s'.stk) ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ s'.stk → s.cnt ≤ s'.disc u →
      l ≤ s'.low u ∧ s'.low u < s'.disc u ∧
      (∀ w, g.has_edge u w → (s'.comp w ≠ 0 ∨ (w ∈ s'.stk ∧ l ≤ s'.disc w))))

/-- Invariant maintained while folding over the adjacency list of `v` (with `disc v = d`). -/
def EInv (g : SCCGraph) (v d : Nat) (s : TState) (lo : Nat) : Prop :=
  Inv g s ∧ v ∈ s.stk ∧ s.disc v = d ∧ s.low v = d ∧ d < s.cnt ∧ lo ≤ d ∧
  (lo < d → ∃ w, w ∈ s.stk ∧ s.disc w = lo ∧ Reach g v w) ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ s.stk → d < s.disc u →
      lo ≤ s.low u ∧ s.low u < s.disc u ∧
      (∀ w, g.has_edge u w → (s.comp w ≠ 0 ∨ (w ∈ s.stk ∧ lo ≤ s.disc w))))

def result (g : SCCGraph) : List (List Nat) :=
  (List.range (run g).ncmp).map
    (fun i => (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun u => (run g).comp u = i + 1))

end Tarjan

/-! ### Paths and reachability -/

theorem is_path_iff (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) :
    g.is_path p ↔ p ≠ [] ∧ List.IsChain g.has_edge p := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hne : p ≠ [] := by
      intro h; subst h; simp at h1
    refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
    rw [List.isChain_iff_getElem]
    intro i hi
    have := h2 i (by omega)
    rwa [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega), List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega)] at this
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨List.length_pos_of_ne_nil h1, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rw [List.isChain_iff_getElem] at h2
    have := h2 i (by omega)
    rwa [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega), List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega)]

theorem chain_append_single {g : SCCGraph} {p : List Nat} {b c : Nat}
    (hc : List.IsChain g.has_edge p) (hl : p.getLast? = some b) (he : g.has_edge b c) :
    List.IsChain g.has_edge (p ++ [c]) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp at hl
  | cons x t ih =>
    match t with
    | [] =>
      simp at hl
      subst hl
      simpa using he
    | y :: t' =>
      rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hl
      have hc' : List.IsChain g.has_edge (y :: t') := (List.isChain_cons_cons.1 hc).2
      have hxy : g.has_edge x y := (List.isChain_cons_cons.1 hc).1
      have := ih hc' hl
      simpa using List.isChain_cons_cons.2 ⟨hxy, this⟩

theorem reach_of_chain (g : SCCGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat) (u v : Nat),
    List.IsChain g.has_edge p → p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v → Reach g u v := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u v _ hh _; simp at hh
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro u v hc hh hl
    simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some_inj] at hh
    subst hh
    rcases t with _ | ⟨y, t'⟩
    · simp at hl; subst hl; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    · have he : g.has_edge x y := (List.isChain_cons_cons.1 hc).1
      have hc' : List.IsChain g.has_edge (y :: t') := (List.isChain_cons_cons.1 hc).2
      have hl' : (y :: t').getLast? = some v := by
        rwa [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hl
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head he (ih y v hc' rfl hl')

theorem reach_of_has_path {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} (h : g.has_path u v) : Reach g u v := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := h
  rw [is_path_iff] at hp
  exact reach_of_chain g p u v hp.2 hh hl

theorem has_path_of_reach {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} (h : Reach g u v) : g.has_path u v := by
  induction h with
  | refl =>
    exact ⟨[u], by rw [is_path_iff]; exact ⟨List.cons_ne_nil _ _, List.isChain_singleton u⟩,
      by simp, by simp⟩
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := ih
    rw [is_path_iff] at hp
    obtain ⟨hne, hc⟩ := hp
    refine ⟨p ++ [c], ?_, ?_, by simp⟩
    · rw [is_path_iff]
      exact ⟨by simp, chain_append_single hc hl hbc⟩
    · match p, hne, hh with
      | x :: t, _, hh => simpa using hh

theorem has_path_iff_reach (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : g.has_path u v ↔ Reach g u v :=
  ⟨reach_of_has_path, has_path_of_reach⟩

/-! ### Generic helpers -/

theorem pairwise_cases {α : Type _} {R : α → α → Prop} {l : List α} (h : List.Pairwise R l)
    {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ l) (hb : b ∈ l) (hab : a ≠ b) : R a b ∨ R b a := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at ha
  | cons x t ih =>
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at h
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha'
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with rfl | hb'
      · exact absurd rfl hab
      · exact Or.inl (h.1 _ hb')
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with rfl | hb'
      · exact Or.inr (h.1 _ ha')
      · exact ih h.2 ha' hb'

theorem popTo_append (v : Nat) (a t : List Nat) (h : v ∉ a) :
    popTo v (a ++ v :: t) = (a ++ [v], t) := by
  induction a with
  | nil => simp [popTo]
  | cons x a' ih =>
    have hx : ¬ (x = v) := by
      intro hh; exact h (by simp [hh])
    have h' : v ∉ a' := by
      intro hh; exact h (by simp [hh])
    simp [popTo, hx, ih h']

theorem countP_lt_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ x, p x = true → q x = true)
    {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ l) (hq : q x = true) (hp : p x = false) :
    l.countP p < l.countP q := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    have hmono : t.countP p ≤ t.countP q := List.countP_mono_left (fun y _ hy => hpq y hy)
    rw [List.countP_cons, List.countP_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx'
    · simp [hp, hq]
      omega
    · have hlt := ih hx'
      by_cases hpa : p a = true
      · have hqa := hpq a hpa
        simp [hpa, hqa]
        omega
      · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hpa
        by_cases hqa : q a = true
        · simp [hpa, hqa]; omega
        · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hqa
          simp [hpa, hqa]; omega

theorem unvis_mono (g : SCCGraph) {s s' : TState} (h : ∀ u, s.disc u ≠ 0 → s'.disc u ≠ 0) :
    unvis g s' ≤ unvis g s := by
  apply List.countP_mono_left
  intro x _ hx
  simp only [beq_iff_eq] at hx ⊢
  by_contra hc
  exact (h x hc) hx

theorem unvis_lt (g : SCCGraph) {s s' : TState} (h : ∀ u, s.disc u ≠ 0 → s'.disc u ≠ 0)
    {v : Nat} (hv : v < g.adj.size) (h0 : s.disc v = 0) (h1 : s'.disc v ≠ 0) :
    unvis g s' < unvis g s := by
  refine countP_lt_of (x := v) ?_ (by simp [hv]) (by simp [h0]) (by simp [h1])
  intro x hx
  simp only [beq_iff_eq] at hx ⊢
  by_contra hc
  exact (h x hc) hx

theorem Grows_refl (s : TState) : Grows s s := by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, ⟨[], by simp, by simp⟩, le_rfl, le_rfl, ?_⟩
  intro u h0 h1; exact absurd h0 h1

theorem Grows_trans {a b c : TState} (h1 : Grows a b) (h2 : Grows b c) : Grows a c := by
  obtain ⟨d1, c1, l1, ⟨p1, hp1, hp1'⟩, n1, m1, e1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨d2, c2, l2, ⟨p2, hp2, hp2'⟩, n2, m2, e2⟩ := h2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ⟨p2 ++ p1, ?_, ?_⟩, le_trans n1 n2, le_trans m1 m2, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu; rw [d2 u (by rw [d1 u hu]; exact hu), d1 u hu]
  · intro u hu; rw [c2 u (by rw [c1 u hu]; exact hu), c1 u hu]
  · intro u hu
    have hub : u ∈ b.stk := by rw [hp1]; exact List.mem_append_right _ hu
    rw [l2 u hub, l1 u hu]
  · rw [hp2, hp1, List.append_assoc]
  · intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx' | hx'
    · have := hp2' x hx'
      by_contra hc
      rw [d1 x hc] at this
      exact hc this
    · exact hp1' x hx'
  · intro u h0 hne
    by_cases hb : b.disc u = 0
    · exact le_trans n1 (e2 u hb hne)
    · rw [d2 u hb] at hne ⊢
      exact e1 u h0 hb

/-- Every stack vertex above `v` reaches `v`, provided all of them have `low < disc`. -/
theorem reach_root (g : SCCGraph) (s : TState) (hinv : Inv g s) (v : Nat) (hv : v ∈ s.stk)
    (hlow : ∀ x, x ∈ s.stk → s.disc v < s.disc x → s.low x < s.disc x) :
    ∀ b, b ∈ s.stk → s.disc v < s.disc b → Reach g b v := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hinj, hstk, hpair, hlw, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hinv
  have key : ∀ k, ∀ b, b ∈ s.stk → s.disc b = k → s.disc v < k → Reach g b v := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ k ihk =>
      intro b hb hbk hlt
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw, hreach⟩ := (hlw b hb).2 (hlow b hb (by omega))
      rcases lt_trichotomy (s.disc w) (s.disc v) with hc | hc | hc
      · refine hreach.trans ?_
        have hne : w ≠ v := by intro hh; rw [hh] at hc; omega
        rcases pairwise_cases hpair hw hv hne with ⟨h1, -⟩ | ⟨-, h2⟩
        · omega
        · exact h2
      · have : w = v := hinj w v (by rw [hc]; exact (hstk v hv).2.1) hc
        rw [← this]; exact hreach
      · have h2 := hlow b hb (by omega)
        exact hreach.trans (ihk (s.disc w) (by omega) w hw rfl hc)
  intro b hb hlt
  exact key (s.disc b) b hb rfl hlt

/-! ### Unfolding lemmas -/

theorem upd_apply (f : Nat → Nat) (k val x : Nat) : upd f k val x = if x = k then val else f x := rfl

theorem assignAll_apply (c : Nat → Nat) (b : List Nat) (i x : Nat) :
    assignAll c b i x = if x ∈ b then i else c x := rfl

theorem visitEdges_nil (g : SCCGraph) (fuel : Nat) (s : TState) (lo : Nat) :
    visitEdges g fuel [] s lo = (s, lo) := by
  rw [visitEdges]

theorem visitEdges_cons (g : SCCGraph) (fuel : Nat) (w : Nat) (ws : List Nat) (s : TState)
    (lo : Nat) :
    visitEdges g fuel (w :: ws) s lo =
      (if s.disc w = 0 then
        visitEdges g fuel ws (visit g fuel w s).1 (min lo (visit g fuel w s).2)
       else if w ∈ s.stk then visitEdges g fuel ws s (min lo (s.disc w))
       else visitEdges g fuel ws s lo) := by
  rw [visitEdges]

theorem visit_succ (g : SCCGraph) (fuel v : Nat) (s : TState) :
    visit g (fuel + 1) v s =
      finishSt (visitEdges g fuel ((g.adj.getD v #[]).toList) (pushSt s v) s.cnt).1 v s.cnt
        (visitEdges g fuel ((g.adj.getD v #[]).toList) (pushSt s v) s.cnt).2 := by
  rw [visit]

theorem finishSt_pop (s : TState) (v d l : Nat) (h : l = d) :
    finishSt s v d l =
      ({ disc := s.disc, low := upd s.low v l, cnt := s.cnt,
         stk := (popTo v s.stk).2,
         comp := assignAll s.comp (popTo v s.stk).1 (s.ncmp + 1),
         ncmp := s.ncmp + 1 }, l) := by
  rw [finishSt, if_pos h]

theorem finishSt_nopop (s : TState) (v d l : Nat) (h : ¬ l = d) :
    finishSt s v d l = ({ s with low := upd s.low v l }, l) := by
  rw [finishSt, if_neg h]

/-! ### Invariant preservation for the individual steps -/

theorem Inv_push (g : SCCGraph) (s s1 : TState) (v : Nat) (hinv : Inv g s) (hv : v < g.adj.size)
    (hdv : s.disc v = 0) (hreach : ∀ b, b ∈ s.stk → Reach g b v)
    (hd1 : ∀ x, s1.disc x = if x = v then s.cnt else s.disc x)
    (hl1 : ∀ x, s1.low x = if x = v then s.cnt else s.low x)
    (hc1 : ∀ x, s1.comp x = s.comp x)
    (hk1 : s1.stk = v :: s.stk) (hn1 : s1.cnt = s.cnt + 1) (hm1 : s1.ncmp = s.ncmp) :
    Inv g s1 := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11⟩ := hinv
  have hvne : ∀ u, u ∈ s.stk → u ≠ v := by
    intro u hu hh
    rw [hh] at hu
    exact (h4 v hu).2.1 hdv
  have hdv' : s1.disc v = s.cnt := by rw [hd1]; simp
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u
    rw [hd1 u, hn1]
    by_cases hu : u = v
    · rw [if_pos hu]; omega
    · rw [if_neg hu]; have := h2 u; omega
  · intro u w hu heq
    rw [hd1 u] at hu heq
    rw [hd1 w] at heq
    by_cases hu' : u = v
    · by_cases hw' : w = v
      · rw [hu', hw']
      · rw [if_pos hu', if_neg hw'] at heq
        have := h2 w; omega
    · by_cases hw' : w = v
      · rw [if_neg hu', if_pos hw'] at heq
        have := h2 u; omega
      · rw [if_neg hu', if_neg hw'] at heq
        rw [if_neg hu'] at hu
        exact h3 u w hu heq
  · intro u hu
    rw [hk1] at hu
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hu with hu' | hu'
    · subst hu'
      refine ⟨hv, by rw [hd1]; simp; omega, ?_⟩
      rw [hc1]
      by_contra hc
      exact (h7 u hc).2.1 hdv
    · have hne := hvne u hu'
      refine ⟨(h4 u hu').1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hd1, if_neg hne]; exact (h4 u hu').2.1
      · rw [hc1]; exact (h4 u hu').2.2
  · rw [hk1, List.pairwise_cons]
    constructor
    · intro b hb
      have hne := hvne b hb
      refine ⟨?_, hreach b hb⟩
      rw [hd1 b, hd1 v, if_neg hne, if_pos rfl]
      exact h2 b
    · refine List.Pairwise.imp_of_mem ?_ h5
      intro a b ha hb hab
      have hane := hvne a ha
      have hbne := hvne b hb
      rw [hd1 a, hd1 b, if_neg hane, if_neg hbne]
      exact hab
  · intro u hu
    rw [hk1] at hu
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hu with hu' | hu'
    · subst hu'
      rw [hl1, hd1, if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl]
      exact ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩
    · have hne := hvne u hu'
      rw [hl1, hd1, if_neg hne, if_neg hne]
      refine ⟨(h6 u hu').1, ?_⟩
      intro hlt
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw, hr⟩ := (h6 u hu').2 hlt
      refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_, hr⟩
      · rw [hk1]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw
      · rw [hd1, if_neg (hvne w hw)]; exact hdw
  · intro u hu
    simp only [hc1] at hu
    have hne : u ≠ v := by
      intro hh; rw [hh] at hu; exact (h7 v hu).2.1 hdv
    simp only [hc1, hm1, hd1, if_neg hne]
    exact h7 u hu
  · intro u hu hnot
    rw [hk1] at hnot
    rw [hd1] at hu
    have hne : u ≠ v := by
      intro hh; exact hnot (by rw [hh]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)
    rw [if_neg hne] at hu
    simp only [hc1]
    exact h8 u hu (fun hc => hnot (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc))
  · intro u w hu heq
    simp only [hc1] at hu heq
    exact h9 u w hu heq
  · intro u w hu he
    simp only [hc1] at hu ⊢
    exact h10 u w hu he
  · intro i hi1 hi2
    rw [hm1] at hi2
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h11 i hi1 hi2
    exact ⟨u, by simp only [hc1]; exact hu⟩

theorem Inv_setlow (g : SCCGraph) (s s' : TState) (v l : Nat) (hinv : Inv g s) (hv : v ∈ s.stk)
    (hle : l ≤ s.disc v)
    (hwit : l < s.disc v → ∃ w, w ∈ s.stk ∧ s.disc w = l ∧ Reach g v w)
    (hd : ∀ x, s'.disc x = s.disc x) (hl : ∀ x, s'.low x = if x = v then l else s.low x)
    (hc : ∀ x, s'.comp x = s.comp x)
    (hk : s'.stk = s.stk) (hn : s'.cnt = s.cnt) (hm : s'.ncmp = s.ncmp) :
    Inv g s' := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u; rw [hd, hn]; exact h2 u
  · intro u w hu heq; rw [hd] at hu heq; rw [hd] at heq; exact h3 u w hu heq
  · intro u hu
    rw [hk] at hu
    exact ⟨(h4 u hu).1, by rw [hd]; exact (h4 u hu).2.1, by rw [hc]; exact (h4 u hu).2.2⟩
  · rw [hk]
    refine List.Pairwise.imp_of_mem ?_ h5
    intro a b ha hb hab
    rw [hd, hd]; exact hab
  · intro u hu
    rw [hk] at hu
    rw [hl, hd]
    by_cases hu' : u = v
    · subst hu'
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      refine ⟨hle, fun hlt => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw, hr⟩ := hwit hlt
      exact ⟨w, by rw [hk]; exact hw, by rw [hd]; exact hdw, hr⟩
    · rw [if_neg hu']
      refine ⟨(h6 u hu).1, fun hlt => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw, hr⟩ := (h6 u hu).2 hlt
      exact ⟨w, by rw [hk]; exact hw, by rw [hd]; exact hdw, hr⟩
  · intro u hu
    simp only [hc] at hu
    simp only [hc, hd, hm]
    exact h7 u hu
  · intro u hu hnot
    rw [hd] at hu; rw [hk] at hnot; simp only [hc]
    exact h8 u hu hnot
  · intro u w hu heq
    simp only [hc] at hu heq
    exact h9 u w hu heq
  · intro u w hu he
    simp only [hc] at hu ⊢
    exact h10 u w hu he
  · intro i hi1 hi2
    rw [hm] at hi2
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h11 i hi1 hi2
    exact ⟨u, by simp only [hc]; exact hu⟩

/-- Popping the SCC rooted at `v`: the popped block is strongly connected and closed under
successors, so all invariants survive. -/
theorem Inv_pop (g : SCCGraph) (s s4 : TState) (v d : Nat) (pre rest : List Nat)
    (hinv : Inv g s)
    (hstk : s.stk = pre ++ v :: rest)
    (hdv : s.disc v = d)
    (hpre : ∀ x, x ∈ pre → d < s.disc x)
    (hrest : ∀ x, x ∈ rest → s.disc x < d)
    (hlow : ∀ u, u ∈ s.stk → d < s.disc u → s.low u < s.disc u)
    (hedge : ∀ u, u ∈ s.stk → d ≤ s.disc u →
        ∀ w, g.has_edge u w → (s.comp w ≠ 0 ∨ (w ∈ s.stk ∧ d ≤ s.disc w)))
    (hd4 : ∀ x, s4.disc x = s.disc x) (hl4 : ∀ x, s4.low x = s.low x)
    (hc4 : ∀ x, s4.comp x = if x ∈ pre ++ [v] then s.ncmp + 1 else s.comp x)
    (hk4 : s4.stk = rest) (hn4 : s4.cnt = s.cnt) (hm4 : s4.ncmp = s.ncmp + 1) :
    Inv g s4 := by
  have hinv0 := hinv
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11⟩ := hinv
  have hvstk : v ∈ s.stk := by rw [hstk]; simp
  have hBmem : ∀ x, x ∈ pre ++ [v] → x ∈ s.stk ∧ d ≤ s.disc x := by
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx' | hx'
    · exact ⟨by rw [hstk]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx', le_of_lt (hpre x hx')⟩
    · have hxv : x = v := by simpa using hx'
      subst hxv
      exact ⟨hvstk, le_of_eq hdv.symm⟩
  have hBof : ∀ x, x ∈ s.stk → d ≤ s.disc x → x ∈ pre ++ [v] := by
    intro x hx hdx
    rw [hstk] at hx
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx' | hx'
    · exact List.mem_append_left _ hx'
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx' with hx'' | hx''
      · subst hx''; simp
      · have := hrest x hx''; omega
  have hBcomp : ∀ x, x ∈ pre ++ [v] → s.comp x = 0 := by
    intro x hx; exact (h4 x (hBmem x hx).1).2.2
  have hrest_not : ∀ x, x ∈ rest → x ∉ pre ++ [v] := by
    intro x hx hc
    have := (hBmem x hc).2
    have := hrest x hx
    omega
  have hreach_to : ∀ x, x ∈ pre ++ [v] → Reach g x v := by
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx' | hx'
    · refine reach_root g s hinv0 v hvstk ?_ x (hBmem x hx).1 (by rw [hdv]; exact hpre x hx')
      intro y hy hlt
      exact hlow y hy (by rw [hdv] at hlt; exact hlt)
    · have hxv : x = v := by simpa using hx'
      subst hxv
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  have hreach_from : ∀ x, x ∈ pre ++ [v] → Reach g v x := by
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx' | hx'
    · have hdx := hpre x hx'
      have hne : x ≠ v := by intro hh; rw [hh, hdv] at hdx; omega
      rcases pairwise_cases h5 (hBmem x hx).1 hvstk hne with ⟨-, hr⟩ | ⟨hlt, -⟩
      · exact hr
      · rw [hdv] at hlt; omega
    · have hxv : x = v := by simpa using hx'
      subst hxv
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u; rw [hd4, hn4]; exact h2 u
  · intro u w hu heq; rw [hd4] at hu heq; rw [hd4] at heq; exact h3 u w hu heq
  · intro u hu
    rw [hk4] at hu
    have hus : u ∈ s.stk := by rw [hstk]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu)
    refine ⟨(h4 u hus).1, by rw [hd4]; exact (h4 u hus).2.1, ?_⟩
    rw [hc4, if_neg (hrest_not u hu)]
    exact (h4 u hus).2.2
  · rw [hk4]
    have hsub : rest.Sublist s.stk := by
      rw [hstk]
      exact (List.sublist_cons_self v rest).trans (List.sublist_append_right pre (v :: rest))
    refine List.Pairwise.imp_of_mem ?_ (List.Pairwise.sublist hsub h5)
    intro a b _ _ hab
    rw [hd4, hd4]; exact hab
  · intro u hu
    rw [hk4] at hu
    have hus : u ∈ s.stk := by rw [hstk]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu)
    rw [hl4, hd4]
    refine ⟨(h6 u hus).1, fun hlt => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw, hr⟩ := (h6 u hus).2 hlt
    have hdu : s.disc u < d := hrest u hu
    have hdwlt : s.disc w < d := by
      have := (h6 u hus).1
      omega
    refine ⟨w, ?_, by rw [hd4]; exact hdw, hr⟩
    rw [hk4]
    rw [hstk] at hw
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hw with hw' | hw'
    · have := hpre w hw'; omega
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw' with hw'' | hw''
      · rw [hw'', hdv] at hdwlt; omega
      · exact hw''
  · intro u hu
    rw [hc4] at hu ⊢
    by_cases hb : u ∈ pre ++ [v]
    · rw [if_pos hb] at hu ⊢
      exact ⟨(h4 u (hBmem u hb).1).1, by rw [hd4]; exact (h4 u (hBmem u hb).1).2.1,
        by omega, by rw [hm4]⟩
    · rw [if_neg hb] at hu ⊢
      exact ⟨(h7 u hu).1, by rw [hd4]; exact (h7 u hu).2.1, (h7 u hu).2.2.1,
        by rw [hm4]; have := (h7 u hu).2.2.2; omega⟩
  · intro u hu hnot
    rw [hk4] at hnot
    rw [hd4] at hu
    rw [hc4]
    by_cases hb : u ∈ pre ++ [v]
    · rw [if_pos hb]; omega
    · rw [if_neg hb]
      refine h8 u hu ?_
      rw [hstk]
      intro hc
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hc with hc' | hc'
      · exact hb (List.mem_append_left _ hc')
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc' with hc'' | hc''
        · exact hb (by rw [hc'']; simp)
        · exact hnot hc''
  · intro u w hu heq
    rw [hc4] at hu heq
    rw [hc4] at heq
    by_cases hbu : u ∈ pre ++ [v] <;> by_cases hbw : w ∈ pre ++ [v]
    · exact (hreach_to u hbu).trans (hreach_from w hbw)
    · rw [if_pos hbu, if_neg hbw] at heq
      have hw0 : s.comp w ≠ 0 := by omega
      have := (h7 w hw0).2.2.2
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hbu, if_pos hbw] at heq
      rw [if_neg hbu] at hu
      have := (h7 u hu).2.2.2
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hbu, if_neg hbw] at heq
      rw [if_neg hbu] at hu
      exact h9 u w hu heq
  · intro u w hu he
    rw [hc4] at hu
    rw [hc4, hc4]
    by_cases hbu : u ∈ pre ++ [v]
    · rw [if_pos hbu] at hu ⊢
      rcases hedge u (hBmem u hbu).1 (hBmem u hbu).2 w he with hc | ⟨hws, hdw⟩
      · have hbw : w ∉ pre ++ [v] := by
          intro hc'; exact hc (hBcomp w hc')
        rw [if_neg hbw]
        have := (h7 w hc).2.2.2
        exact ⟨hc, by omega⟩
      · rw [if_pos (hBof w hws hdw)]
        exact ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg hbu] at hu ⊢
      obtain ⟨hc, hle⟩ := h10 u w hu he
      have hbw : w ∉ pre ++ [v] := by
        intro hc'; exact hc (hBcomp w hc')
      rw [if_neg hbw]
      exact ⟨hc, hle⟩
  · intro i hi1 hi2
    rw [hm4] at hi2
    by_cases hlast : i = s.ncmp + 1
    · exact ⟨v, by rw [hc4, if_pos (by simp)]; omega⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h11 i hi1 (by omega)
      have hu0 : s.comp u ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hbu : u ∉ pre ++ [v] := by
        intro hc'; exact hu0 (hBcomp u hc')
      exact ⟨u, by rw [hc4, if_neg hbu]; exact hu⟩

theorem stack_reach_v (g : SCCGraph) (v d : Nat) (s : TState) (lo : Nat) (hE : EInv g v d s lo) :
    ∀ b, b ∈ s.stk → Reach g b v := by
  obtain ⟨hinv, hvs, hdv, hlv, hdc, hlod, hwit, hcls⟩ := hE
  have hinv' := hinv
  obtain ⟨-, -, hinj, hstk, hpair, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hinv
  intro b hb
  rcases lt_trichotomy (s.disc b) d with hc | hc | hc
  · have hne : b ≠ v := by intro hh; rw [hh, hdv] at hc; omega
    rcases pairwise_cases hpair hb hvs hne with ⟨h1, -⟩ | ⟨-, h2⟩
    · rw [hdv] at h1; omega
    · exact h2
  · have hbv : b = v := hinj b v (by rw [hc, ← hdv]; exact (hstk v hvs).2.1) (by rw [hc, hdv])
    rw [hbv]
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  · refine reach_root g s hinv' v hvs ?_ b hb (by omega)
    intro x hx hlt
    exact (hcls x hx (by rw [hdv] at hlt; exact hlt)).2.1

theorem edge_fact_mono (g : SCCGraph) {s s' : TState} (hinv : Inv g s) (hG : Grows s s')
    {lo lo' w : Nat} (hle : lo' ≤ lo)
    (h : s.comp w ≠ 0 ∨ (w ∈ s.stk ∧ lo ≤ s.disc w)) :
    s'.comp w ≠ 0 ∨ (w ∈ s'.stk ∧ lo' ≤ s'.disc w) := by
  obtain ⟨gd, gc, gl, ⟨pre, hpre, -⟩, -, -, -⟩ := hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hstk, -, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hinv
  rcases h with h | ⟨hw, hd⟩
  · left; rw [gc w h]; exact h
  · right
    refine ⟨by rw [hpre]; exact List.mem_append_right _ hw, ?_⟩
    rw [gd w (hstk w hw).2.1]
    omega

theorem EInv_step_child (g : SCCGraph) (v d : Nat) (s s' : TState) (lo l w : Nat)
    (hE : EInv g v d s lo) (hvw : g.has_edge v w) (hdw : s.disc w = 0)
    (hP : Post g w s s' l) : EInv g v d s' (min lo l) := by
  obtain ⟨hinvA, hvs, hdv, hlv, hdc, hlod, hwit, hcls⟩ := hE
  obtain ⟨hinvB, hG, hdw', hlcnt, hpop, hnopop, hclause⟩ := hP
  have hG0 := hG
  have hinv0 := hinvA
  have hinv1 := hinvB
  obtain ⟨gd, gc, gl, ⟨pre, hpre, hpre0⟩, gcnt, gncmp, gnew⟩ := hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hstk, -, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hinvA
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hstk', -, hlw', -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hinvB
  have hvs' : v ∈ s'.stk := by rw [hpre]; exact List.mem_append_right _ hvs
  have hdvs' : s'.disc v = d := by rw [gd v (hstk v hvs).2.1]; exact hdv
  have hlvs' : s'.low v = d := by rw [gl v hvs]; exact hlv
  refine ⟨hinv1, hvs', hdvs', hlvs', by omega, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hlt
    rcases le_total lo l with hc | hc
    · rw [min_eq_left hc] at hlt ⊢
      obtain ⟨w0, hw0, hd0, hr0⟩ := hwit hlt
      exact ⟨w0, by rw [hpre]; exact List.mem_append_right _ hw0,
             by rw [gd w0 (hstk w0 hw0).2.1]; exact hd0, hr0⟩
    · rw [min_eq_right hc] at hlt ⊢
      obtain ⟨hlw, hws⟩ := hnopop (by omega)
      obtain ⟨w0, hw0, hd0, hr0⟩ := (hlw' w hws).2 (by rw [hlw, hdw']; omega)
      exact ⟨w0, hw0, by rw [hd0, hlw], Relation.ReflTransGen.head hvw hr0⟩
  · intro u hu hdu
    by_cases hcase : s.cnt ≤ s'.disc u
    · obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hclause u hu hcase
      refine ⟨by omega, c2, fun w' he => ?_⟩
      rcases c3 w' he with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h1, by omega⟩
    · have hu0 := hu
      have hus : u ∈ s.stk := by
        rw [hpre] at hu0
        rcases List.mem_append.1 hu0 with hu' | hu'
        · exfalso
          have h0 := hpre0 u hu'
          have := gnew u h0 (hstk' u hu).2.1
          omega
        · exact hu'
      have hdus : s'.disc u = s.disc u := gd u (hstk u hus).2.1
      have hlus : s'.low u = s.low u := gl u hus
      obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hcls u hus (by omega)
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, fun w' he => ?_⟩
      exact edge_fact_mono g hinv0 hG0 (min_le_left _ _) (c3 w' he)

theorem EInv_step_stack (g : SCCGraph) (v d : Nat) (s : TState) (lo w : Nat)
    (hE : EInv g v d s lo) (hvw : g.has_edge v w) (hws : w ∈ s.stk) :
    EInv g v d s (min lo (s.disc w)) := by
  obtain ⟨hinv, hvs, hdv, hlv, hdc, hlod, hwit, hcls⟩ := hE
  refine ⟨hinv, hvs, hdv, hlv, hdc, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hlt
    rcases le_total lo (s.disc w) with hc | hc
    · rw [min_eq_left hc] at hlt ⊢; exact hwit hlt
    · rw [min_eq_right hc] at hlt ⊢
      exact ⟨w, hws, rfl, Relation.ReflTransGen.single hvw⟩
  · intro u hu hdu
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hcls u hu hdu
    refine ⟨by omega, c2, fun w' he => ?_⟩
    rcases c3 w' he with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h1, by omega⟩

theorem Grows_push (s s1 : TState) (v : Nat) (hdv : s.disc v = 0) (h1 : 1 ≤ s.cnt)
    (hd1 : ∀ x, s1.disc x = if x = v then s.cnt else s.disc x)
    (hl1 : ∀ x, s1.low x = if x = v then s.cnt else s.low x)
    (hc1 : ∀ x, s1.comp x = s.comp x)
    (hk1 : s1.stk = v :: s.stk) (hn1 : s1.cnt = s.cnt + 1) (hm1 : s1.ncmp = s.ncmp)
    (hstkd : ∀ u, u ∈ s.stk → s.disc u ≠ 0) :
    Grows s s1 := by
  refine ⟨?_, fun u _ => hc1 u, ?_, ⟨[v], by rw [hk1]; simp, ?_⟩, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    have hne : u ≠ v := by intro hh; rw [hh] at hu; exact hu hdv
    rw [hd1, if_neg hne]
  · intro u hu
    have hne : u ≠ v := by intro hh; rw [hh] at hu; exact (hstkd v hu) hdv
    rw [hl1, if_neg hne]
  · intro x hx
    have : x = v := by simpa using hx
    rw [this]; exact hdv
  · intro u h0 hne
    rw [hd1] at hne ⊢
    by_cases hu : u = v
    · rw [if_pos hu]
    · rw [if_neg hu] at hne; exact absurd h0 hne

/-! ### The main induction: correctness of `visit` -/

theorem main_spec (g : SCCGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) : ∀ fuel : Nat,
    ∀ v s, Inv g s → v < g.adj.size → s.disc v = 0 → (∀ b, b ∈ s.stk → Reach g b v) →
      unvis g s ≤ fuel → Post g v s (visit g fuel v s).1 (visit g fuel v s).2 := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro v s hinv hv hdv hreach hfuel
    exfalso
    have hpos : 0 < unvis g s := by
      have hmem : v ∈ (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun u => s.disc u == 0) := by
        simp [List.mem_filter, hv, hdv]
      rw [unvis, List.countP_eq_length_filter]
      exact List.length_pos_of_mem hmem
    omega
  | succ fuel ihf =>
    have hedges : ∀ (v d : Nat) (ws : List Nat) (s : TState) (lo : Nat),
        (∀ w, w ∈ ws → g.has_edge v w) → EInv g v d s lo → unvis g s ≤ fuel →
        EInv g v d (visitEdges g fuel ws s lo).1 (visitEdges g fuel ws s lo).2 ∧
        Grows s (visitEdges g fuel ws s lo).1 ∧
        (visitEdges g fuel ws s lo).2 ≤ lo ∧

            refine ⟨hres.1, hres.2.1, by have := hres.2.2.1; omega, hres.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩

    -- the body of `visit`
    intro v s hinv hv hdv hreach hfuel
    have hinvA := hinv

    rw [visit_succ]
    have hfold := hedges v s.cnt ((g.adj.getD v #[]).toList) (pushSt s v) s.cnt
      hwsedge hE1 hunvis1
    set S2 := (visitEdges g fuel ((g.adj.getD v #[]).toList) (pushSt s v) s.cnt).1 with hS2def

    have hinv2A := hE2.1
    obtain ⟨hinv2, hv2, hdv2, hlv2, hdc2, -, hwit2, hcls2⟩ := hE2
    obtain ⟨-, hb2, hj2, hs2, -, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hinv2

      have hlL : L < s.cnt := by omega
      refine ⟨hinv3, ?_, hdv2, hle2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine ⟨fun u hu => hG02.1 u hu, fun u hu => hG02.2.1 u hu, ?_,
          ⟨pre ++ [v], by rw [hstk2]; simp, ?_⟩, hG02.2.2.2.2.1, hG02.2.2.2.2.2.1,
          hG02.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩
        · intro u hu
          have hne : u ≠ v := by intro hh; rw [hh] at hu; exact (h4 v hu).2.1 hdv

/-! ### The driver loop -/

theorem unvis_le (g : SCCGraph) (s : TState) : unvis g s ≤ g.adj.size := by
  have := List.countP_le_length (l := List.range g.adj.size) (p := fun u => s.disc u == 0)
  simpa using this

theorem loop_spec (g : SCCGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) : ∀ k i s,
    Inv g s → s.stk = [] → i + k ≤ g.adj.size → (∀ u, u < i → s.comp u ≠ 0) →
    Inv g (loop g k i s) ∧ (loop g k i s).stk = [] ∧
      (∀ u, u < i + k → (loop g k i s).comp u ≠ 0) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i s hinv hstk _ hcov
    rw [loop]
    exact ⟨hinv, hstk, by simpa using hcov⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i s hinv hstk hik hcov
    rw [loop]
    have hi : i < g.adj.size := by omega
    by_cases hdi : s.disc i = 0
    · rw [if_pos hdi]
      have hpost := main_spec g hwf (g.adj.size + 1) i s hinv hi hdi
        (by rw [hstk]; simp) (by have := unvis_le g s; omega)
      obtain ⟨hinv', hG', hdi', hle', hpop', hnopop', -⟩ := hpost
      have hinvC := hinv'
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, hstkC, -, hlwC, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hinv'
      obtain ⟨gd, gc, gl, ⟨pre, hpre, hpre0⟩, gcnt, gncmp, gnew⟩ := hG'
      have heq : (visit g (g.adj.size + 1) i s).2 = s.cnt := by
        by_contra hne
        have hlt : (visit g (g.adj.size + 1) i s).2 < s.cnt := by omega
        obtain ⟨hlow, hmem⟩ := hnopop' hlt
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw, -⟩ := (hlwC i hmem).2 (by rw [hlow, hdi']; omega)
        rw [hpre, hstk] at hw
        simp only [List.append_nil] at hw
        have := gnew w (hpre0 w hw) (hstkC w (by rw [hpre, hstk]; simpa using hw)).2.1
        rw [hdw, hlow] at this
        omega
      obtain ⟨hstk', hcomp'⟩ := hpop' heq
      have hrec := ih (i + 1) _ hinvC (by rw [hstk', hstk]) (by omega) ?_
      · exact ⟨hrec.1, hrec.2.1, fun u hu => hrec.2.2 u (by omega)⟩
      · intro u hu
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u i with hc | hc
        · rw [gc u (hcov u hc)]; exact hcov u hc
        · have : u = i := by omega
          rw [this]; exact hcomp'
    · rw [if_neg hdi]
      have hrec := ih (i + 1) s hinv hstk (by omega) ?_
      · exact ⟨hrec.1, hrec.2.1, fun u hu => hrec.2.2 u (by omega)⟩
      · intro u hu
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u i with hc | hc
        · exact hcov u hc
        · have huv : u = i := by omega
          obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, h8, -, -, -⟩ := hinv
          rw [huv]
          exact h8 i hdi (by rw [hstk]; simp)

theorem Inv_init (g : SCCGraph) : Inv g initState := by
  refine ⟨le_rfl, fun u => by simp [initState], ?_, by simp [initState], by simp [initState],
    by simp [initState], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u w hu _; simp [initState] at hu
  · intro u hu; simp [initState] at hu
  · intro u hu; simp [initState] at hu
  · intro u w hu; simp [initState] at hu
  · intro u w hu; simp [initState] at hu
  · intro i hi1 hi2; simp [initState] at hi2; omega

/-! ### The core correctness statement of the algorithm -/

theorem core (g : SCCGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    (∀ u, u < g.adj.size → (run g).comp u ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ u, (run g).comp u ≠ 0 → u < g.adj.size ∧ (run g).comp u ≤ (run g).ncmp) ∧
    (∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ (run g).ncmp → ∃ u, (run g).comp u = i) ∧
    (∀ u v, (run g).comp u ≠ 0 → (run g).comp u = (run g).comp v → Reach g u v) ∧
    (∀ u w, (run g).comp u ≠ 0 → g.has_edge u w →
      (run g).comp w ≠ 0 ∧ (run g).comp w ≤ (run g).comp u) := by
  obtain ⟨hinv, -, hcov⟩ :=
    loop_spec g hwf g.adj.size 0 initState (Inv_init g) rfl (by omega) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, h7, -, h9, h10, h11⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨fun u hu => hcov u (by omega), fun u hu => ⟨(h7 u hu).1, (h7 u hu).2.2.2⟩,
    h11, h9, h10⟩

/-- From the five core facts about the component labelling, the postcondition follows. -/
theorem main_from_core (g : SCCGraph) (cmp : Nat → Nat) (k : Nat)
    (hcov : ∀ u, u < g.adj.size → cmp u ≠ 0)
    (hbnd : ∀ u, cmp u ≠ 0 → u < g.adj.size ∧ cmp u ≤ k)
    (hnem : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ∃ u, cmp u = i)
    (hsame : ∀ u v, cmp u ≠ 0 → cmp u = cmp v → Reach g u v)
    (hclos : ∀ u w, cmp u ≠ 0 → g.has_edge u w → cmp w ≠ 0 ∧ cmp w ≤ cmp u) :
    g.is_valid_scc_result
      ((List.range k).map (fun i => (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun u => cmp u = i + 1))) := by
  have hmono : ∀ u v, Reach g u v → cmp u ≠ 0 → cmp v ≠ 0 ∧ cmp v ≤ cmp u := by
    intro u v h hu
    induction h with
    | refl => exact ⟨hu, le_rfl⟩
    | @tail b c _ hbc ih =>
      obtain ⟨hb, hble⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨hc, hcle⟩ := hclos b c hb hbc
      exact ⟨hc, le_trans hcle hble⟩
  have hmem : ∀ i u, u ∈ (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun u => cmp u = i + 1) ↔
      (u < g.adj.size ∧ cmp u = i + 1) := by
    intro i u
    simp [List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]
  have hmemres : ∀ c, c ∈ (List.range k).map
      (fun i => (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun u => cmp u = i + 1)) ↔
      ∃ i, i < k ∧ c = (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun u => cmp u = i + 1) := by
    intro c
    simp [List.mem_map, List.mem_range, eq_comm]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- Nodup
    rw [List.nodup_map_iff_inj_on List.nodup_range]
    intro i hi j hj hij
    by_contra hne'
    rw [List.mem_range] at hi hj
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hnem (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    have hun : u < g.adj.size := (hbnd u (by omega)).1
    have h1 : u ∈ (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun u => cmp u = i + 1) := by
      rw [hmem]; exact ⟨hun, hu⟩
    rw [hij, hmem] at h1
    omega
  · -- coverage
    intro u hu
    have hun : u < g.adj.size := hu
    have hu0 : cmp u ≠ 0 := hcov u hun
    have hle : cmp u ≤ k := (hbnd u hu0).2
    refine ⟨(List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun x => cmp x = (cmp u - 1) + 1), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hmemres]; exact ⟨cmp u - 1, by omega, rfl⟩
    · rw [hmem]; exact ⟨hun, by omega⟩
  · -- disjointness
    intro c1 c2 h1 h2 hne' u hu1
    rw [hmemres] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := h2
    rw [hmem] at hu1 ⊢
    intro hu2
    exact hne' (by rw [show i = j by omega])
  · -- strong connectivity
    intro c hc
    rw [hmemres] at hc
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨u0, hu0⟩ := hnem (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    have hu0n : u0 < g.adj.size := (hbnd u0 (by omega)).1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hm : u0 ∈ (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun u => cmp u = i + 1) := by
        rw [hmem]; exact ⟨hu0n, hu0⟩
      exact List.length_pos_of_mem hm
    · intro u hu
      rw [hmem] at hu
      exact hu.1
    · intro u v hu hv

      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
